entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who tries to tame the Chain Veil, learns that Avacyn is dead and that Nahiri is free, and sets off toward Thraben with an army of the dead.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: A geistmage and spirit expert supplied by Olivia who helps Liliana test the Chain Veil and is killed by werewolves, then reanimated.

entities.name: Gared
entities.description: Dierk's one-big-eyed assistant who follows Liliana.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire noblewoman at Lurenbraum Fortress who rejoices at Avacyn's death and joins Sorin to fight Nahiri.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who blames Liliana for freeing the Lithomancer and leads the vampires to battle Nahiri.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer freed from the Helvault, whose vengeance is warping Innistrad.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage Liliana grudgingly worries about, who is heading to Thraben.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel Olivia reports dead.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon slain by Liliana.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane being warped by Nahiri's vengeance.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: Liliana's manor with a tower where she experiments, overrun by werewolves.

entities.name: Lurenbraum Fortress
entities.description: A cliff-side citadel of vampires in Stensia, home of Olivia.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A province of Innistrad where Vess Manor and Lurenbraum Fortress stand.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city glowing in the distance toward which Jace and Liliana head.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The coastal region where Nahiri's vengeance mass originates.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A province toward which the storm mass tips.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison that Liliana broke open, releasing the archangel, demons and the Lithomancer.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A necromantic artifact containing thousands of souls whose backlash cannot be tamed by geist circuitry.

entities.name: Witchbane Orb
entities.description: An orb used as a spectral antenna in the experiment, owned by Olivia.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Warped werewolves with misshapen bodies that overrun Vess Manor and kill Dierk.

entities.name: Voldaren Vampires
entities.description: The vampires of the Voldaren bloodline gathered at Lurenbraum Fortress who march to battle Nahiri.

events.summary: Liliana, Dierk and Gared try to tame the Chain Veil by channeling lightning and geists through a witchbane orb.
events.quote: Liliana's teeth clenched involuntarily as the surge came.

events.summary: The geist circuit fails to draw off any backlash, and the Veil's pain overwhelms Liliana.
events.quote: The geist circuit had not drawn off any of the backlash.

events.summary: The equipment is ruined and Liliana cries out; she dismisses Dierk, who takes the orb to Olivia.
events.quote: You may see yourself out. Deliver the orb back to its owner.

events.summary: Liliana wants Jace to owe her, then hears a scream and finds werewolves overrunning her throne room.
events.quote: Werewolves. Liliana's entire throne room was overrun.

events.summary: The warped werewolves kill Dierk, raking his chest open.
events.quote: Dierk lay on the floor, his chest raked open.

events.summary: Liliana, Gared and the reanimated Dierk reach the door of Lurenbraum Fortress.
events.quote: Finally, Liliana, Gared, and—haltingly—Dierk, arrived at the monumental door.

events.summary: A vampire priest turns Liliana away until Olivia appears and welcomes her.
Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

events.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
events.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

events.summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
events.quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

events.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
events.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

events.summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
events.quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

events.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
Liliana sees the vengeful cloud mass from Nephalia tipping toward Thraben.
events.quote: the atmospheric mass shifted slowly from its origin over the Nephalia coast, tipping toward Gavony province and the brightly lit High City.

events.summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
events.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

events.summary: Liliana walks toward Thraben and raises the dead from cemeteries along the road.
events.quote: Corpses crawled up out of the earth.

events.summary: Liliana, with a growing horde of zombies, declares she is this world's last hope.
events.quote: A dozen more zombies lurched out of the ground, compelled to follow in her wake of necromantic power.

relations.quote: Not even Olivia's premier geist expert had been able to tame the Veil.
She had slain the demon Griselbrand
Dierk lay on the floor, his chest raked open.

relations.note: She tells herself she does not need him, only wants to be needed.
relations.quote: But it wasn't that she needed Cloak Boy, she told herself.

relations.note: He says she is free and they must face her.
relations.quote: The Lithomancer is free, and now we must face her.

relations.note: He warns that meddlers in his affairs die.
relations.quote: You meddle in my affairs, you die.

relations.note: She fights beside him as part of a bargain.
relations.quote: It's time for you to fulfill your end of the bargain.
